label: Pixel 8a smartphone
description: Google Pixel 8a — 6.1-inch mid-range Tensor G3 phone, Wi-Fi 6E and 5G sub-6 GHz only; USB-C 3.2 with Ethernet adapter support.
notes: Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5/6 GHz) — no Wi-Fi 7 despite the Pixel 8 nameplate. Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz only, no mmWave. USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 with Ethernet adapter support (usb0). Useful as the 'same family, lesser radio' counterpart to Pixel 8.
